integrity: The exact threshold is proved analytically by a signed inverse-Laplace representation and periodic sign argument; numerical checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Only a three-parameter degree-five family with the two distinct frequencies in ratio 3:2; not the full quintic problem. Historical originality remains a best-knowledge assessment, not proof of global novelty.
title: A sharp nonvertical quintic Hausdorff-moment threshold at the three-to-two frequency ratio
